rules.theme-applied: The theme's CSS is on the page and applies.
rules.token-colors: Every colour the app draws is one of the theme's colour tokens (or a mix of two).
rules.token-fonts: Text is set in the theme's fonts.
rules.token-overrides: The app does not set --piq-* tokens; the theme does.
rules.widget-overrides: The app does not restyle SDK widgets.
rules.sdk-widgets: Icons, the logo, loaders and controls come from the SDK, not drawn by the app.
rules.outside-theme: Everything visible is inside the themed element.
rules.brand: The page's favicon and logo follow the theme.
rules.fonts: The theme's fonts are loaded, from the SDK.
rules.contrast: Text meets WCAG AA contrast (axe color-contrast).
rules.reflow: The page does not scroll sideways at the audited width (WCAG 1.4.10 at 320px).
rules.target-size: Pointer targets are at least the theme's minimum target size (WCAG 2.5.8).
rules.focus-obscured: A focused control is never hidden behind sticky or fixed content (WCAG 2.4.11).
rules.one-modal: At most one modal dialog is open at a time (rule modal.one-at-a-time).
rules.modal-contract: An open modal has a name, a way out, and closes on Escape (rules modal.titled, modal.dismiss).
rules.one-primary-action: Each page region or dialog has at most one primary button (rule emphasis.one-primary).
rules.nav-per-breakpoint: Navigation suits the width: few destinations when narrow, standing when wide (rules nav.compact-destinations, nav.standing-at-expanded).
rules.line-length: Lines of prose stay readable (rule text.line-length).
rules.ai-disclose: AI-generated content is labelled as AI-made, by itself or a labelled region (rule ai.disclose).
rules.ai-stop: While the AI works, a Stop or Pause control is in or beside its status (rule ai.stop).
rules.ai-correct: AI-generated content has a retry, regenerate, edit or undo control (rule ai.correct).
rules.ai-starters: An empty conversation offers suggested starting points, and the prompt stays open (rule ai.starters).
rules.ai-declared: With --blueprint: a screen showing AI content declares its AI role (rule ai.declared).
rules.agent-approval: An approval offers approve and deny, neither chosen for the user (rule agent.approve-high-impact).
rules.agent-plan: An agent's plan has steps, each stating its status in text (rule agent.plan-visible).
rules.agent-interrupt: A running agent can be paused or stopped (rule agent.interrupt).
rules.agent-who-acts: Where the user can take over, a live region says who is acting (rule agent.who-acts).
rules.agent-recover: A failed step says what went wrong and can be retried or stepped back from (rule agent.recover).
rules.agent-summary: A finished run shows a summary of what was done (rule agent.summary).
rules.genui-review-prefill: Values the AI pre-fills in inline UI are editable and submitted by the user's own control (rule genui.review-prefill).
rules.card-input-label: Every input in generated UI has a label of its own (rule card.input-label).
rules.card-narrow-first: With --width: generated UI does not scroll sideways at the compact size class (rule card.narrow-first).

items.label: The theme's design system is the one in use: its tokens, fonts and brand, nothing restyled
The palette passes contrast in every appearance
Pages reflow, pointer targets are large enough and focus is never hidden
items.fix: Give the page scroll-padding for its sticky header and bars, so a focused control scrolls clear of them (the SDK's AppShell does).

modality.note: No blueprint modalities and no --modality: responsive-web was assumed.
fixes: AppShell is missing: Build the app in the SDK's AppShell (@ux-builder/ui/patterns), whose navigation adapts by size class: a bottom bar when compact, a rail at medium, a side navigation from expanded.
evidence: AppShell on none of the 1 audited page

rule.title: A focused control is never hidden
rule.statement: A control that receives keyboard focus is never entirely hidden behind sticky or fixed content.

findings.message: focused, it is hidden behind html > body > div > div
findings.fix: Give the page scroll-padding for its sticky header and bars, so a focused control scrolls clear of them (the SDK's AppShell does).

rule.title: Content reflows without sideways scrolling
rule.statement: The page does not scroll sideways at the audited width, down to 320 CSS pixels.

findings.message: the page scrolls sideways at 320px (content 916px wide; widest: html > body > div > div)
findings.fix: Let the content wrap at narrow widths: no fixed width wider than the window, and wide content (tables, code) scrolling in a region of its own.
